description.title: הצעת ביטוח אחריות מקצועית
description.summary: This table captures risk assessment details for professional liability insurance for investment advisors. It's used to determine underwriting considerations based on 'Yes/No' answers and detailed explanations regarding past misconduct or investigations.
description.embed_passage: טופס זה משמש להערכת סיכונים עבור ביטוח אחריות מקצועית ליועצי השקעות. השאלות בטופס בודקות היסטוריה של פעילות פלילית, הונאה, או חקירות רגולטוריות הקשורות לבעלי תפקידים בחברה המבקשת ביטוח. תשובות 'כן' דורשות מתן פרטים נוספים בגיליון נפרד. הטופס בודק גם האם המלצות שהועלו בעקבות חקירות יושמו. בין הנושאים הנבדקים: האם היו הרשעות פליליות, האם התקיימו חקירות רגולטוריות, והאם המלצות יושמו. השאלות מתייחסות לפעילות של שותפים, דירקטורים ועובדים.

sketch:
a) Are there any other facts of which Underwriters should be made aware? Yes / No
Have any present of former partners or directors or employees of the Proposer ever been found guilty of any criminal, dishonest or fraudulent activity and/or investigated by any professional association? If Yes, please give details:
Has the Proposer or any of its directors, officers, partners or employees been subject to, or currently under any regulatory investigation? Yes / No If Yes , please provide full details on a separate sheet.
Did such an investigation result in disciplinary proceeding, admonishments or recommendations? Yes / No
If Yes please provide full details on a separate sheet.
If Yes , were all recommendations implemented? If No , please provide details on a separate sheet.

טבלה: הצעת ביטוח אחריות מקצועית
This table captures risk assessment details for professional liability insurance for investment advisors. It's used to determine underwriting considerations based on 'Yes/No' answers and detailed explanations regarding past misconduct or investigations.
ממדים: risk assessment question, response (Yes/No) + details (if applicable)

a) Are there any other facts of which Underwriters should be made aware? Yes / No
Have any present of former partners or directors or employees of the Proposer ever been found guilty of any criminal, dishonest or fraudulent activity and/or investigated by any professional association? If Yes, please give details:
Has the Proposer or any of its directors, officers, partners or employees been subject to, or currently under any regulatory investigation? Yes / No If Yes , please provide full details on a separate sheet.
Did such an investigation result in disciplinary proceeding, admonishments or recommendations? Yes / No
If Yes please provide full details on a separate sheet.
If Yes , were all recommendations implemented? If No , please provide details on a separate sheet.
